description:
Draft an email, SMS or direct-mail message with Spur's AI. Returns text only; nothing is sent. Pass owner_id/property_id to personalize with real owner and property data.

Uses 1 AI credit. Use {{merge_fields}} like {{owner_first_name}} and {{property_address}} to keep it reusable (see resource spur://merge-variables).

channel.description: Which kind of message to draft

prompt.description: What to write, e.g. "friendly first touch asking if they would sell, mention we close in cash"

property_id.description: Saved property the message is about

name: spur_draft_message
title: Draft outreach message
